## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. For example: I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which component would this feature enhance?
- [ ] Final Exam Mark Predictor

## Expected benefits
Explain how this feature would benefit users of the system. For example:
- Would it improve prediction accuracy?
- Would it enhance user experience?
- Would it save time or resources?
- Would it enable new use cases?

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, please share them here.

## Mockups/Examples (optional)
If applicable, add mockups or examples from other systems to help illustrate your feature request.

## Additional context
Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
